header: Confirm that OSPF Connections are Established
content:
View the System log to confirm that the firewall has established OSPF connections.
STEP 1 |
Select Monitor > System and look for messages to confirm that OSPF adjacencies have been
established.
STEP 2 |
Select OSPF > Neighbor and examine the Status column to determine if OSPF adjacencies
have been established (are full).
